label: Gala

provenance.incarnation: President James Johnson in original MGS2 Plant: mature pale man, broad lined square jaw, strong nose, short dark graying slicked-back hair, clean-shaven, natural visible eyes and bare hands; same facial identity as original low-resolution game portrait, not a real public figure likeness. Original CQC Gala clothes and combat animations, not official commercial costume.

sources.scope: Original final-game native130x91 face/upper shirt portrait; full original lower-body clothes are not certified, gala outfit is authored adaptation.
